welcome.reviewsTitle: Trusted across Moscow and St. Petersburg

steps.title: Find a place leaving soon
steps.body: Browse verified apartments being passed on directly by the current renter.

steps.title: Buy tokens
steps.body: One pack of tokens is 3 contacts. You can talk to only one landlord at a time. Every member is identity-verified.

steps.title: Meet & take it over
steps.body: View the place, discuss, and agree on the move-in date and thank-you. Make sure the owner is ready to rent it to you at the stated price. Pay the landlord for their service (off-platform).

seekItems: Today's rental market gives every advantage to owners and realtors, leaving tenants — hardly the wealthiest group — out in the cold. The whole burden of searching and costs falls on the tenant.
On our platform you can reach the leaving tenant and get access to the apartment before anyone else on the market — before it ever lands in the hands of realtors.
You can agree on more flexible viewing and move-in dates, on furniture and other details that realtors can't offer.
When you move out, you can also list the apartment on our platform with no commission.

reviews.quote: Found my one-bedroom in Khamovniki in a week — no agent, no fee, just messaged the person moving out. Wild that this actually works.
reviews.name: Maria R.

reviews.quote: I was moving to another city and handed my place on Vasilyevsky to someone verified in two days. So much easier than posting a sublet.
